'''Zenscarab''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Humbeetle]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Hierotyrus]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The halo atop Zenscarab's head beguiles approaching Tatari into becoming followers. To Zenscarab, there are only two kinds of Tatari: those who love the signature dish, and those who have not tasted it yet."

Zenscarab is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Zenscarab's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Hierotyrus]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B Tier
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (Dig up treasure x120) or [[Cozy Farm]] (Use Fertilizer x7200)
* In Tatari Catcher, capture 200 Tatari. Get new converts!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 03/11/2026, its bio description said: "Zenscarab's said routine: 1) Fight Zobos, 2) Go home. 3) Be a chef, a guru, and a professional poop-scooper. ---The Poo-phet."
* Prior to the update on 05/12/2026, its bio description said: "The halo atop Zenscarab's head beguiles approaching Tatari into becoming followers. Claims to be of divinity and spreads forbidden wisdom, and anyone who lays eyes on Zenscarab's true form is said to lose their sanity."
